title: What are the most gleefully depraved scenes?

commenti.body: All of evil dead 2, and even most of evil dead rise. Maybe leans a bit too heavily into camp and outright comedy for your tastes but Jesus Christ if you take a step back and think about what you’re watching…. That is some depraved shit right there

You would really like Blood Meridian (book)
Apparently it's going to become a movie finally but it's gonna be really hard to adapt
Same author as No Country for Old Men but way way way more killing

I would say the end scene of The Killing of a Sacred Deer, the content is so heavy but the execution had me cracking up. Or the end of Midsommar for that matter. I don't think they hold a candle to the house that jack built though haha
I think you misunderstood my prompt. I've read Blood Meridian and I'm definitely not having a good time...

I’ve always been rather fascinated by depravity that has nothing to do with physical violence but everything to do with mental games. 

I found Hitchcocks “Notorious” grand in that respect. Here you got Carey Grant who convinces the woman he loves to seduce and marry a Nazi for him and then punishes her afterwards for doing exactly  what he asked of her. It’s so deliciously sick. Same with another Hitchcock movie, Vertigo, where Stewart forces a woman to transform her entire self and personality into a dead woman he once loved. Also sick. 

And then there’s the mental games in the 90s Cruel Intentions. Now I know that most certainly isn’t Hitchcock, but it is still brilliantly depraved and fascinating.
